title: Oscar Harada Aguilar at Stanford GSB — 'AI can help us build faster, but it can't replace the human ability to learn what truly matters'
summary: A Stanford Graduate School of Business student lists Eric alongside Dragoneer's Marc Stad and Rubrik's Bipul Sinha as the three minds he learned from in one week, describes getting his decade-old copy of The Lean Startup signed, and records the line he took from the conversation.
blockquote: I bought and loved The Lean Startup about 10 years ago. Never imagined I'd get to meet the author, have a conversation, and get my book signed while promoting his new book! And a fun fact he shared: he was once at Stanford GSB himself, not as a student, but as an SO (Significant Other)! His message was especially relevant today: AI can help us build faster, but it can't replace the human ability to learn what truly matters.
